data.name: Nataniel
data.gender_notes: Nataniel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nataniel means 'given by God'. In the Bible, Nataniel is a disciple of Jesus and one of the twelve apostles. The name Nataniel carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nataniel usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nataniel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nataniel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Nataniel
in_english.long_meaning: Nataniel is a name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning God has given, it is mentioned in the New Testament as one of the twelve Apostles, and holds significant importance in Christian tradition and cultural heritage

data.cultural_impact: Nataniel holds a significant place in Christian history as one of the twelve apostles hand-picked by Jesus Christ himself. His name symbolizes the idea of God's divine direction and intervention in the life of an individual.
data.spiritual_significance: Nataniel represents the belief in God's sovereignty and provision in one's life. His name serves as a reminder that everything we have and are is ultimately a gift from God. It encourages a heart of gratitude and dependence on God's grace and mercy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nathaniel means "given of God" or "grace of God". This name symbolizes God's divine intervention and grace in the life of the bearer. It is a reminder of God's presence and guidance, encouraging faith and trust in His plan.

biblical_reference.note: Nataniel is mentioned as one of Jesus' twelve Apostles

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nathaniel of Magdala, a 1st century CE disciple of Jesus, mentioned in the New Testament. The name Nataniel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
Nathaniel the Wise, a character in the 12th century CE work 'The Stories of the Sages' by Moses ben Maimon (Maimonides).

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nataniel remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: John Nataniel, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Nataniel meaning "Given by God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
